certificate_denominator_audit.note: drift inputs are exact Fraction.from_float values (no 1e-6 rounding); the <= 20-bit claim applies only to the fixed-radix accumulator above, by construction (denominator divides 10^6)

grinding_audit.model: transcript = SHA-256(colony_seed, epoch, quantized delta, verifier_nonce); NOT cryptographic; grindable with a public/fixed nonce; binding only when the verifier draws a fresh nonce after the proposer commits to the delta

haar_probe_refresh_audit.verifier_nonce_model: fixed PUBLIC nonce for the screening trials (stated); the binding holds only with a fresh verifier nonce per submission — see grinding_audit

rational_bitlength_audit.quantizer_direction: up (conservative: drift-like values never round down)
